description: FieldOpt is a C++ research tool for petroleum field-development optimisation, including well placement, reservoir controls and inflow-control devices. It connects configurable objectives and algorithms with external reservoir simulators. The provider is Petroleum Cybernetics Group. Coverage: The software is generic, not a measured geographic dataset. Spatial detail and simulation periods are supplied by the user. Access: The public source repository provides documentation and installation instructions. Source archives and dependencies were not downloaded or run. Licence and cost: The README distinguishes GPLv3 for the project from LGPLv3 for WellIndexCalculator. Simulator dependencies may carry separate terms. Limitations: Build instructions and external simulator access are required. Parallel execution and algorithm results were not tested. For simulation it supports optimisation experiments across multiple model realisations. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers FieldOpt.
